competing_explanation: The policy may have changed to a different return window, or the claim may conflate standard items with special, final-sale, or category-specific return terms.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: H_P is refuted if the authoritative current policy states a different return window, denies full refunds for standard items, or applies the 30-day full-refund window only to non-standard items.
